response.query: How will we separate within-bank from between-bank mediation in the two-level SEM, and which centering/aggregation rules (group-mean vs grand-mean) will be pre-specified?
response.answer: To separate within-bank from between-bank mediation in two-level SEM, use group-mean centering. Grand-mean centering is not pre-specified.
